gates.description: Security pipeline configuration must be documented
SAST scan must be configured in the pipeline
Dependency vulnerability scanning must be configured
No hardcoded secrets in pipeline configuration
Container image scanning must be configured
CVE remediation SLA must be defined (critical: 24h, high: 7d)

anti_patterns.description: Every PR waits 2 hours for security scans — developers bypass the pipeline
Scanner produces 500 findings, most low severity — developers ignore all of them
Running scanners without anyone looking at the results
Using one scanner assuming full coverage — each scanner catches different things

escalation_triggers: Critical CVE affects a production system and no patch is available
SAST or DAST discovers a critical vulnerability in a live production feature
Pipeline security checks are being bypassed systematically
A supply chain attack is suspected (compromised dependency, unauthorized code change)
Secret exposure detected in a public repository or logs

input_requirements.description: Spec.md to understand what security controls are needed

output_certifications: SAST scan configured on every PR
No hardcoded secrets in pipeline config
